newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Iran Dec crude exports fall to 2.401 mln bpd - MEES.
newsitem.headline: Iran Dec crude exports fall to 2.401 mln bpd - MEES.

text.p: Iran's crude oil exports averaged 2.401 million bpd in December, a fall of 254,000 bpd from the November average of 2.655 million bpd, the Middle East Economic Survey reported on Monday.

"Allowing for estimated deliveries to domestic refineries of 1.2 million bpd in December (up 100,000 bpd from throughput in November), Iran's crude oil production for the month is put at 3.601 million bpd as compared with 3.755 million bpd in November," it said.
MEES said that Iranian crude exports for the year as a whole rose 1.8 percent to an average of 2.558 million bpd compared with the 1995 average of 2.512 million bpd.
The National Iranian Oil Company's (NIOC) December lifting averaged 816,000 bpd against 1.042 million bpd in November, it added.
MEES said Japanese companies lifted 539,000 bpd in December, compared to 554,000 bpd in November.
